integration_recommendation: Integrate the two frozen modules as one program-order extension for the existing packed-uint8 logical host profile after root catalog registration and integration checks. Do not claim native instruction-level concurrency or whole-task acceptance.

semantic_findings.result: The inspected original wrapper allocates bf16 output with doubled final dimension and uses ceilDiv(numel,512). The admitted FPSource retains masked byte load, high-then-low nibble interleave, sign/zero/denormal/exponent/mantissa operations, bitcast to fp32, bf16 cast and masked store. Host.parameters fixes block=512, and Host.expectedMemory is an independent initial-byte lookup for every output cell.
semantic_findings.limit: This extension uses the existing packed-uint8, nonscalar contiguous logical profile. It does not add a complete host exception/allocator/device/dtype refinement.

semantic_findings.result: program_memory derives ActiveBytes from PackedInput for that pid, uses actual execution_memory, constructs the unique lane o%1024 for writes, and proves the complement by the inherited frame. Writes is exactly output region, output bounds and o/1024=pid. program_value maps local nibble parity and byte offset to the global initial-byte reference. The result includes all regions and offsets, with no fixed predecessor order.
semantic_findings.limit: One-program value reads are from that program-entry memory. Freshness is not needed for this local snapshot theorem, but is explicitly required to lift it across schedules.

semantic_findings.topic: Typed input preservation across actual executions
semantic_findings.result: runSchedule performs actual full source exec then recurses on its final state; programState resets registers and sets pid/grid while retaining preceding memory and undef. Fresh h.input != h.output makes program_memory preserve the entire input region. The induction reestablishes PackedInput and proves cell h next = cell h initial, so later computations retain original bytes. No input preservation or successful-run fact is supplied as a premise.
semantic_findings.limit: Freshness is an explicit logical region premise motivated by torch.empty. Its correspondence to native physical memory, allocator freshness and storage offsets is unproved.

semantic_findings.result: scheduledMemory is independent of exec/source and uses only initial packed cells plus membership of each output block in jobs. schedule_correct proves this for every finite list of natural pids. Repeated pids rewrite the same values because input is unchanged; pids beyond the original grid have no active writes. Arbitrary order is handled by list induction and membership, not by an assumed commuting-program equation.
semantic_findings.limit: Out-of-grid pids in the stronger helper are abstract logical executions, not claimed legal native launches.

semantic_findings.result: complete_schedule requires every original pid below grid to occur, derives o/1024<grid for every in-bounds output using grid_covers, and upgrades scheduledMemory to exactly Host.expectedMemory. It still permits duplicates/extras. The public specification derives coverage from jobs.Perm(List.range(grid h)), so each actual grid program appears exactly once. The public frame follows for all other regions and all offsets past doubled count; zero-sized and partial-tail cases are included. Distinct pids have disjoint logical write footprints.
semantic_findings.limit: The theorem establishes equal final memory for arbitrary sequential orders of complete programs. It does not quantify over GPU instruction/warp interleavings or prove a native memory model refinement. Final registers need not agree across orders.

public_premises: typed: every active input cell is a tagged natural equal to an 8-bit payload
order: jobs is a permutation of every original grid pid exactly once
necessary_changes_before_scoped_integrat: No Lean source repair is required for the currently stated theorem.
Register the exact specification/source hashes and classify the added result as arbitrary sequential program-order independence over the inherited packed-input profile.
Keep native instruction interleavings, physical aliases/allocator, unrestricted input dtype and host caller/error domain open; do not promote whole-task acceptance.
Root must run integration validation against registered sources; exclude temporary .olean outputs and dependency symlinks.
remaining_nondeferrable_gaps: Native GPU instruction interleavings/parallel scheduling refinement; theorem compares complete sequential program executions.
Physical byte memory, allocator freshness and tensor/storage-offset/ABI correspondence.
Unrestricted Python input dtype and caller/error domain, host tensor allocation and compiler/resource/address admission.
Fixed-width pid/count/offset arithmetic, overflow, physical allocation bounds, device/contiguity assertion behavior and zero-grid native admission are inherited unresolved boundaries.
The original wrapper has no input dtype assertion. PackedInput is a selected storage domain and does not certify other original caller dtypes.

supporting_evidence.independent_reference_check: scheduledMemory avoids runSchedule, execution, FP.Structural.exec and source; inspected successful log.

validation_limits.proof_hole_scan: No sorry/admit/custom axiom/unsafe/partial/native_decide found in the two new sources.
validation_limits.note: Read-only independent semantic review of the two new modules, original Python, Host/FPCorrect/FPContract/FPReference/FPSource dependencies, and verification of all receipt-bound sources/dependencies/final compiler logs. Producer exit codes were not rerun by this reviewer.
